name: Sinopros Corporation Limited
summary: Sinopros Corporation Limited is a Hong Kong-headquartered investment holding company focused on hotels and property in China, founded in 1993. Its segments cover property investment in Yingkou, Jinggangshan and Zhongshan, property development and sales, hotel operations, financial advisory help in obtaining financing, and healthcare planning and management services for healthcare operators. A further unallocated segment holds the remaining operations, including the corporate office.
